properties.bounds: no loops; in_len 0..8, cap 0..256, every byte value; CBMC 6.4.1

properties.bounds: no loops; in_len 0..8, cap 0..256, every byte value; CBMC 6.4.1

findings.title: A length byte of 255 wraps the 8-bit frame total to 0, so frame_decode copies 255 bytes from a shorter input
findings.evidence: FAIL test_length_255_reads_past_input: FrameReadsInBounds violated: SUMMARY: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow ... in memcpy

refuted_claims.claim: src/frame.h:9-10 says frame_decode 'never reads or writes outside in[0..in_len) and out[0..cap)'
refuted_claims.result: CBMC shows a read past in for in[0] = 255 and in_len 1..8

coverage_gaps.area: inputs longer than 8 bytes, NULL buffers
coverage_gaps.reason: harness assumptions (CORRESPONDENCE.md); the read bug already shows at every length 1..8
